Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the temporal context and misidentified the election numbering. The 58th quadrennial U.S. presidential election was the 2016 election (held on November 8, 2016), which occurred after the March 8, 2016 Michigan Democratic primary. The Planner incorrectly claimed the 2020 election as the 58th (it is the 59th) and prematurely marked the task complete without verification.
